buildCommand: apk add --no-cache curl tar xz && curl -L https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.25.1-stable.tar.xz -o flutter.tar.xz && tar xf flutter.tar.xz && export PATH="$PWD/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter config --enable-web && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release
